figurative_meaning_en: To get married and establish a family
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে শীঘ্রই ঘর বাঁধার চিন্তা করছে।
তাদের ঘর বাঁধা হয়েছে গত বছর।
example_sentences_in_english: He is thinking of tying the knot soon.
They set up house last year.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on marriage as the foundation of family life.
